source: Thursday, 06:00 in The Flinty & Steel, in which Othello leads everyone in a drinking game. Brigand: Yeh can't shirk payment forever. Othello: ... Friends, please stay here. Gentlemen. I see that reason has failed your master once more. For the last time: My word is good, but so long as my coin goes to the king, I've nothing to pay with. What more can I offer you? Horatio: Othello! Irma: What—! Brigand: Our master sends 'is final word. Brigand: If you've truly nothin', we'll take blood. Othello: Ngh... Irma: Aimed for the heart, got 'im in the shoulder. Half-wits. Quickly—I must bandage it. You. Fetch me cloth. Horatio: Ah—ah—yes! I've found some. Behind the bar. Irma: Quiet. Hold him still. Horatio: I do so despise blood. Irma: Then look away, and let me work. This is the kind of thing you don't learn in that university of yours. There. That should do it. He's lucky only his arm was pierced. Othello becomes upset but will recover overnight. Othello: My thanks, Irma. You're too kind. Can't believe they got me so easily. Heh. I'm all right, friends. I feel better even as we speak. Irma: Don't move that arm. Othello: It's my sword arm. Am I not to defend myself against thugs? Irma: If you don't let it heal, you won't be alive to ask yourself such introspective questions! Horatio: ...Othello. It may be time to consider alternative options. Hiding, for example. A thoroughly tried and true strategy—if not the most noble. You could go anywhere. Why, you could visit my hometown of Venice! Othello: I'm not leaving. That's not up for discussion. Irma: Hmph. Suit yourself. You're more stubborn than even I. Horatio: Irma, I think it's high time we retired for the evening. Let's leave Othello to lick his wounds. Ophelia acquires the information "Barkeep in Trouble." Ophelia learns more about The Barkeep and Me. The entry will be updated in the Journal. Bernardo: Ophelia? Ophelia: Yes? Bernardo: I'm sorry to be the one to tell you this. Your father is dead. There was an... altercation with the Prince. My lady, if there's anything I can do... Ophelia: No, Bernardo. That's quite all right. I'll see him again soon enough. Bernardo: I can only hope so. May we all be reunited in Heaven. Ophelia: Heaven. Of course. My father... there was something he wanted me to have. A key to the chest in his room. Bernardo: Ah, yes. We did find something like that. It's yours now. The least I can do, my lady. I'm truly sorry, Ophelia. But... now I must inform the rest of the castle.
target: 星期四 06:00，燧石与钢酒馆，事件：奥赛罗带大家玩饮酒游戏。 强盗: 你别想一直赖着不还钱。 奥赛罗: ……朋友们，请留在这里。 先生们。看来你们的主人又一次失去了理智。 我最后再说一次：我说话算数，可只要我的钱还得交给国王，我就没钱还债。我还能拿什么给你们？ 霍拉旭: 奥赛罗！ 伊尔玛: 什么——！ 强盗: 我们主人让我们带来最后一句话。 强盗: 你要是真没钱，就拿血来还。 奥赛罗: 唔…… 伊尔玛: 瞄着心脏，却打中了肩膀。一群蠢货。 快——我得包扎一下。你。给我拿块布来。 霍拉旭: 啊——啊——是的！ 我找到了。在吧台后面。 伊尔玛: 安静。扶住他，别让他动。 霍拉旭: 我实在讨厌血。 伊尔玛: 那就看别处去，让我干活。这种事，你在那所大学里可学不到。 好了。这样应该就行了。他运气不错，只有胳膊被刺穿了。 奥赛罗心烦意乱，但过一夜就会恢复。 奥赛罗: 谢谢你，伊尔玛。你真是太好了。 真不敢相信，他们这么轻易就伤到了我。呵。 我没事，朋友们。就说话这会儿，我已经感觉好多了。 伊尔玛: 别动那条胳膊。 奥赛罗: 这是我握剑的胳膊。难道遇上暴徒，我也不能自卫吗？ 伊尔玛: 你要是不让伤口愈合，就没命再琢磨这些自省的问题了！ 霍拉旭: ……奥赛罗。也许该考虑别的出路了。 比如躲起来。这可是久经考验、确实行得通的办法——虽然不怎么光彩。 你去哪儿都行。对了，你可以去我的家乡威尼斯看看！ 奥赛罗: 我不会走。这件事没得商量。 伊尔玛: 哼。随你的便。你比我还固执。 霍拉旭: 伊尔玛，我想我们今晚也该回去休息了。让奥赛罗自己养伤吧。 奥菲莉娅获得了信息“酒馆老板的麻烦”。 奥菲莉娅进一步了解了酒馆老板与我。相关条目会在笔记中更新。 贝尔纳多: 奥菲莉娅？ 奥菲莉娅: 嗯？ 贝尔纳多: 很抱歉，要由我来告诉你这个消息。 你父亲去世了。 他与王子发生了……冲突。 女士，如果有什么我能做的…… 奥菲莉娅: 不用了，贝尔纳多。没关系。我很快就会再见到他。 贝尔纳多: 但愿如此。愿我们都能在天堂重聚。 奥菲莉娅: 天堂。当然。 我父亲……他有样东西想交给我。是他房间里那只箱子的钥匙。 贝尔纳多: 啊，是的。我们确实找到了这样的东西。 现在归你了。女士，这点小事是我应该做的。 我真的很难过，奥菲莉娅。不过……我现在必须去通知城堡里的其他人。
